title: Man United come back from 2-0 down to beat Roma
lead: Manchester United were losing 2-0 at half-time, but they won 3-2 against Roma in the Champions League.
body: On Tuesday 3 November 2026, Manchester United played against Roma, an Italian club, at Old Trafford in the Champions League. United were in a bad period: they hadn't won a match for 9 games.

The start was terrible for United. Matías Soulé scored for Roma in the 11th minute, and Donyell Malen scored a penalty in the 18th minute. At half-time, it was 2-0 for Roma. It was a difficult first half for the home fans.

But in the second half, United came back. Matheus Cunha scored, and Bruno Fernandes scored a penalty. His first shot was saved, but the referee told him to take it again because some Roma players were in the box too early. It was 2-2!

Then, in the 86th minute, Shea Lacey passed the ball to Cunha, and he scored the winning goal: 3-2! Sadly, Cunha was sent off at the end because of a silly foul. But United have finally won a match again, and their coach, Michael Carrick, said it was "an important night".
